label: Read research paper
description: Inspect, prepare, or read a bounded cited slice of one local paper. Inspect before broad reading, prepare only when extraction is incomplete, and use pages or chunks to retrieve evidence with stable citations. Keep reads targeted and use the returned next_page or next_start for later slices instead of overlapping or requesting the same content repeatedly.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local paper document ID returned by search_research_library; do not use an arXiv ID, title, path, or the string "null".
parameter_descriptions.action: inspect for structure/status, prepare for extraction, pages for page slices, or chunks for indexed chunks.
parameter_descriptions.start: For pages, the 1-based page number (0 also means the first page); for chunks, the zero-based chunk offset. Use JSON null for inspect or prepare.
parameter_descriptions.limit: Number of pages or chunks to return, from 1 to 10.
